Other markets showed weakness, with sales in Ukraine plummeting by 58.3% to 15 thousand EUR, and sales in the Baltics and other regions declining by 16.7% and 5.1% respectively.

EBITDA margin... 26.3% from 26.6%... Net profit margin attributable to equity holders of the Parent company... 13.9% against 20.3%...'

candidate_sentences.text: The gross margin expanded significantly to 55.6% from 53.1% in the previous year.
However, operating profit decreased by 3.5% to 5,751 thousand EUR, resulting in an operating margin of 20.1%, down from 21.0%.
Consolidated EBITDA also saw a marginal decline of 0.8% to 7,508 thousand EUR.
Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company dropped to 3,961 thousand EUR, a decrease of 31.5% from the prior year’s 5,781 thousand EUR.

candidate_sentences.text: Liquidity improved markedly, with cash and cash equivalents nearly doubling to 12,443 thousand EUR from 6,639 thousand EUR at the end of 2025.
Operating cash flow surged by 96.6% to 6,842 thousand EUR, reflecting efficient working capital management, evidenced by a decrease in inventories and current liabilities.
